artifacts.retention: Generated compiler inputs and export manifests are retained. Successful fixture shared libraries are disposable and removed by the existing test fixture. The flat mode export sink reuses a label between the HighC shadow case and the native roundtrip; an isolated shadow-artifact replay preserves that otherwise overwritten compiler input and manifest.

totals.deduplication: Focused and superseded runs are not added to primary counts; alternate-core replays are reported separately.

superseded_attempts.red-build-and-red-build2: Initial test fixture compile and symbol-name mistakes are diagnostics, not semantic red evidence. red-corrected uses exact-type adapters and has 11 real unsupported-owner failures per SDK.
superseded_attempts.mode-expanded: 13/14 passed per SDK. STI/MOV SS export required scheduled_events, subsequently supplied.
superseded_attempts.mode-shadows: 14/15 passed on r6. MOV SS test lacked the explicit segment access-order binding, subsequently supplied.
superseded_attempts.mode-build4: Successful builds saw source edits during execution and are excluded from final qualification.
superseded_attempts.mode-focused-final: 15/15 passed per SDK on stable source before integration. The merged full suite supersedes these runs.

cleanup.verification: All decompressed member hashes were verified before removing the 22 superseded fixture directories; active artifacts and all reports remain retained.

review: Independent read-only review found and verified fixes for full-bank publication, CR2 receipts, event handoff, retired tokens, cumulative completion counts and missing frozen choices; the final review found no additional blocker within this admitted scope. EFER read/write capability and read-only-bit cases were added.
boundaries: The complete continuous mode stream uses one initial KVM_SET_SREGS per original CPU run and no intermediate host mode rewrites. Four additional original streams compare legacy/IA-32e event frames. KVM is the execution reference; this does not claim bare-metal microcode qualification.
This is an internal C++ embedding boundary with generated Long64 source bodies, not a general mixed-mode C export request or a new stable SDK layout.
NeverC compiles x64 host source only. Guest protected/compatibility code16/code32 remains explicit machine state and does not add a NeverC 32-bit target.
Non64 task/system-selector/segment-reload/debug-register/fast-system/port/string/MPX/legacy-return and call-gate integration remains explicit separate work.
Real/unreal execution, software SMM/SGX, unbound external/device event producers and full mode/task integration remain global gaps.
The supplied GitHub Actions runners previously had no usable SGX1/EPC/device and executed zero enclave instructions; this checkpoint adds no physical SGX evidence.
No final LLVM release is declared. Production pin neverd-llvm-v23.0.0-r6 and the LLVM gitlink remain unchanged.
